name: vapor
description_en: 💧 A server-side Swift HTTP web framework.
readme_excerpt: Vapor is an HTTP web framework for Swift. It provides a beautifully expressive and easy-to-use foundation for your next website, API, or cloud project. Take a look at some of the awesome stuff created with Vapor. 💧 Community Join the welcoming community of fellow Vapor developers on Discord. 🚀 Contributing To contribute a feature or idea to Vapor, create an issue explaining your idea or bring it up on Discord.
